QUOTE: Python does not embed or wrap the engine in an object model. It loads `librentropic.so` with `ctypes` and calls the C ABI in `include/entropic/entropic.h` directly. ... The package is pure Python and holds no native code.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names ctypes over librentropic.so as the mechanism and says the package is pure Python with no native code, so no compiled extension module is involved.
